condition.narrative: No later than four (4) months after the Effective Date or any other later date agreed upon in writing with the Association, thePIE shall recruit for the Project an external auditor in accordance with the Procurement Regulations.

No later than four (4) months after the Effective Date or any other later date agreed upon in writing with the Association, the PIEshall recruit for the Project: (i) a procurement specialist, (ii) a financial and accounting officer, (iii) an internal auditor,and (iv) a social and gender specialist; all with terms of reference, qualifications and experience acceptable to the Association.

No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date or at a later date agreed upon in writing with the Association, theRecipient shall open a separate treasury account or Bank account (Project Account B) and shall maintain the Project Account B openfor a period of not less than eight (8) months after the Closing Date, for the exclusive purpose of depositing funds provided bythe Recipient for the financing of the Project (“Counterpart Funding”), in an amount not to exceed twenty (20) million UnitedStates dollars (US$20,000,000).

Not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, or any later date agreed upon in writing with the Association, the Recipientshall update the Subsidiary Agreement, in form and substance satisfactory to the Association, to reflect additional or scaled-upactivities financed through this Agreement (section I.B.4 of the Schedule 2 of the legal agreement).

title.narrative: Households with complete information in Social Registry

comment.narrative:
Number of households included in the Social Register database and for which socio-economic data have been collected and recorded. Since March 2022 the Social Register covers the whole territory including Nouakchott. With the completion of Nouakchott the register has reached and exceeded its target of 200,000 households with complete data. The social register has also continued the complete update and its scaling.
<Of the 307,811 households with complete data in the register, 18,141 are refugee households that were registered in September 2021 (see sub-indicator). The register has exceeded its initial target of 7,500 refugee households. This is because initially only refugees in categories 1, 2 and 3 (based on UNHCR categorization) were to be included, as they are the most vulnerable. However, it was later agreed with UNHCR that all households would be included, regardless of their category in the database.

title.narrative: Community members reporting positive feedback on household registration outcome for the Social Registry

comment.narrative: The value reported in this ISR is from spot checks undertaken by October 2024 and represents the percentage of individuals answering "yes, I fully agree" or "yes, I rather agree" to the question "do you agree that the households included in the social Registry are the poorest of your community ?". title.narrative: Beneficiaries of social safety net programs

comment.narrative: This Indicator represents the total number of beneficiaries of the social safety net programs including those assisted by Tekavoul, & COVID-19 response in February 2021, and those supported this lean season Elmaouna pilot Tekavoul shock. The calculation avoids the double counting of Tekavoul beneficiaries who also received a Covid 19 support with the shock response programs. The number of total beneficiaries has slightly decreased, as it previously included a double counting between Tekavoul and the COVID-19 response. By October 2023, 1,207,927 beneficiaries had received support from the project 90,849 households : 545,094 individuals were supported by the COVID-19 response. Tekavoul (in addition to Tekavoul shock horizontal expansion) reached 62,508 households through project funds (i.e. 468,810 individuals). Elmaouna reached a cumulative 69,294 households between 2020 and 2023-of which 70% are assumed to be already covered by Tekavoul The slight increase is due to TK choc

title.narrative: Beneficiaries of social safety net programs

comment.narrative: 1) Tekavoul reached 54,664 households (424,561 individuals) between 2020 and 2025. 2) Elmaouna reached 85,310 households (402,471 individuals) between 2020 and 2025 for the lean season, however 70 percent of those are assumed to already be covered by Tekavoul, so to avoid double-counting only 30 percent of those has been included in the total number of people reached for this indicator. 3) Tekavoul choc reached 16,482 households (98,892 individuals) between 2020 and 2025 (only horizontal expansion, i.e. not already covered by Tekavoul. 4) Covid 19 response: 545,894 5) Flood responses in 2023, 2024: 17,160

title.narrative: Cases from the Social Registry grievance redress mechanism addressed in a timely manner

comment.narrative: Percentage of complaints or requests for information received by Tekavoul that have been resolved within 45 days. The majority of claims received by the Tekavoul GRM pertain to requests for information on payment schedules or about other social programs.

title.narrative: Cases from the Social Registry grievance redress mechanism addressed in a timely manner

comment.narrative: Percentage of complaints or requests for information received by the Social Registry that have been resolved within 60 days. The decrease in the share of complaints or requests resolved on time is due to need to do verifications in the field of such complaints and the delays in the ability to go to the field. Complaints or requests pertaining to change in information or to be included requre a verification exercise and can only be considered closed following a field mission.

title.narrative: Cases from the Tekavoul grievance redress mechanism addressed in a timely manner

comment.narrative: Percentage of complaints or requests for information received by Tekavoul that have been resolved within 45 days. The majority of claims received by the Tekavoul GRM pertain to requests for information on payment schedules or even about other social programs. As such resolving these requests can be done on the phone with near immediacy.

title.narrative: Pilot activity to enhance civil registration among vulnerable population
Pilot activity to enhance civil registration among vulnerable population

comment.narrative: An expert in charge of enrollment support was recruited by the project unit, several collection missions were launched, a technical support committee was set up with the Agency in charge of enrollment, and the government signed a convention between the Registry and ANRPTS. Several Moughataas have benefited from the enrollment support.

title.narrative: Early warning system improved with the support of the project

comment.narrative: The EWS will be considered as improved if at least two of the following criteria have been met: (i) better disaggregation of information, (ii) more timely and accurate forecasts (iii) better information dissemination. The FIFI model has been used several times by the government and has been integrated in the Harmonized Framework, contributing to decision-making. Meanwhile, the government hired a consulting firm to digitize the SAP forecasting tools and put the application online for testing before transferring it to the server and hosting it at DGTIC.
